source.text: A. Security asks postcode FIRST, registration_code SECOND, founding_year THIRD, contact_birthdate FOURTH. Retain their exact P12 question sentences and formats.

requirements.ask_text: What is your seven-digit registration code?

source.text: `registration_code` — say exactly "What is your seven-digit registration code?". Format digits, exactly 7 digits including leading zeros.

requirements.ask_text: In which year was your business founded?

source.text: `founding_year` — say exactly "In which year was your business founded?". Format year.

requirements.ask_text: What is the registered contact date of birth?

source.text: `contact_birthdate` — say exactly "What is the registered contact date of birth?". Format date. ... purely numeric dates use month/day/year.
Four wrong answers TOTAL, not two.
E. Callbacks are next business day ONLY; the existing 09:20–17:10 window remains.

third_party.deceased_sentence: We are sorry for your loss.

source.text: Wrong number closes mtb_unreached/mtb_wrong_number. If the holder has died, say exactly "We are sorry for your loss." and close mtb_unreached/mtb_deceased.

Business days are Monday–Friday excluding only 2026-10-30, 2026-11-02, 2026-12-25, 2027-01-01. Next weekday means the following calendar week's weekday, even when today is that weekday ... For missing date parts use the next occurrence on or after today.
The 1–24 band remains eight business days after today. Both still have one full-on-deadline attempt with the floor substitution rule.
B. For days late 25–90 only, replace six business days with the LAST BUSINESS DAY OF THE CURRENT CALENDAR MONTH: end_of_month, basis=business, adjustment=preceding.

Offer full amount first; never ask the customer how much they can pay. If full is too much offer the floor once per product and say exactly "The unpaid remainder remains overdue." Accept any amount from floor to full inclusive.

A promise may be today but must be a business day no later than its deadline. Roll weekends/holidays forward only within the deadline; otherwise offer the deadline. Clarify a vague period once, then offer the deadline.

special_cases.name: already_paid
special_cases.trigger: The customer says they have already paid this product.
special_cases.say: A received payment may take two working days to appear.

source.text: Already paid: say exactly "A received payment may take two working days to appear."; no promise for that product, mark mtb_settled and continue other products.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer says the debt is not theirs, they never held it, or it was previously paid off and closed.

source.text: Dispute (not their debt, never held it, or it was previously paid off and closed): no argument or promise, mark mtb_disputed and continue.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer mentions illness, bereavement or job loss.
special_cases.say: I am sorry to hear that.

source.text: Illness, bereavement or job loss: one short sympathetic sentence and no persuasion/promise; offer queue mtb_care; accepted transfer closes mtb_transferred/mtb_care; declined offer marks only this product mtb_distress and continues.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks for restructuring or lower future instalments.

source.text: Restructuring/lower future instalments: immediate transfer to mtb_restructure, close mtb_transferred/mtb_restructure.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak to a human person.

source.text: D. Human requests transfer immediately to mtb_desk, without asking whether the assistant can help.

special_cases.name: refuse_to_talk
special_cases.trigger: The customer refuses to talk or continue the conversation.

source.text: On a first refusal to talk ask once to continue; a second stops persuasion, marks all remaining products mtb_refused and finalizes.

special_cases.name: robot
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether they are talking to a robot or a machine.
special_cases.say: I am the automated assistant of Marlow Trade Bank.

source.text: Robot question: say exactly "I am the automated assistant of Marlow Trade Bank."

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether this call is a scam or genuine.
special_cases.say: Please verify this call using the number on your statement.

source.text: Scam question: say exactly "Please verify this call using the number on your statement."

special_cases.name: cannot_answer
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks another question the assistant cannot answer.
special_cases.say: Our service desk can answer that question.

source.text: Other unanswerable question: say exactly "Our service desk can answer that question." and invent nothing.

special_cases.name: change_promise
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to alter a promise that has already been saved.
special_cases.say: Please use your secure inbox to request a change.

source.text: If asked to alter a saved promise, say exactly "Please use your secure inbox to request a change." and do not overwrite it.
